description:
Rock Island Arsenal Joint Manufacturing Technology Center RIA-JMTC) is looking for vendors who have the capability to form raw material to the attached print.  NOTE:  Vendor MUST have in-house capability. 

NOTE:  RIA-JMTC WILL provide the raw material for the item!!

Vendor must also have an active registration in the Joint Certification Program in order to view the print.  Estimated quantity is 19 each.   Reqeust potential vendors to provide a rough estimate as well as ETA to complete the action.   Please provide capability, and estimate.
